stories.story_fr: Au 1er trimestre 2026, le revenu differe lie aux evenements atteint 6,6 Mds $ (+22%), le plus gros solde de revenu differe de l'histoire de la societe, signe d'une demande de billets pre-vendue tres forte pour les concerts a venir.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026, event-related deferred revenue reached $6.6 billion (up 22%), the largest deferred revenue balance in company history, reflecting strong pre-sold ticket demand for upcoming shows.
stories.signal: Event-related deferred revenue of $6.6 billion, up 22% largest deferred revenue balance in company history

stories.story_fr: Des avril, plus de 85% des concerts en grandes salles de 2026 sont deja reserves (confirmes ou en offre), avec un nombre de dates en hausse sur les stades, arenas et amphitheatres, ce qui securise tres tot la visibilite sur l'annee.
stories.story_en: By April, over 85% of 2026 large-venue shows are already booked (confirmed and offer-in), with show counts up year-over-year across stadiums, arenas and amphitheaters, securing visibility on the year very early.
stories.signal: We have already booked over 85% of our large-venue shows for the year, with show counts up year-over-year across stadiums, arenas, and amphitheaters

stories.story_fr: En 2025, Live Nation a investi pres de 15 Mds $ dans les artistes et les spectacles, se positionnant comme le premier soutien financier des artistes au monde, un levier structurel pour alimenter l'offre de concerts.
stories.story_en: In 2025, Live Nation invested nearly $15 billion in artists and shows, reinforcing its position as the leading financial supporter of artists, a structural lever to fuel concert supply.
stories.signal: Invested nearly $15 billion in artists and shows, reinforcing Live Nation as the leading financial supporter of artists
